tab.description: The tab the command acted on.

result.description: The value as JSON (`null` for undefined); with `return_by_value: false`, its description; when cut, the cut string or JSON text.

type.description: JavaScript's type: object, function, undefined, string, number, boolean, symbol or bigint.

subtype.description: For objects: array, null, node, regexp, date, map, set, error, promise, ...

page_generation.description: The tab's page generation: it grows when the main frame navigates or the document is replaced (DOM.documentUpdated). Refs are valid only in the generation that issued them.
